# Atelier Orbite — QA assets only

The three photographs are from [scikit-image v0.24.0](https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/tree/v0.24.0/skimage/data): `rocket.jpg` (SpaceX, DSCOVR launch), `astronaut.png` (NASA, Eileen Collins) and `moon.png` (lunar surface). See the upstream `data/_fetchers.py` for image credits. No association with or endorsement by these subjects is implied.

`orbit.svg` is an original test mark. `launch.mp4` is a moving zoom of the launch photo, not authentic launch footage. `note.wav` is a locally synthesized 392 Hz tone with an amplitude envelope. The acceptance test uploads these files as a customer would. They are never seeded into a customer library or used as renderer fallbacks.
